sources.evidence: Wiki page 'History - ICPC 1993' reports the 1993 World Finals in Indianapolis (Harvard champions), not a Rocky Mountain regional.

facts.contest_named: 1992-93 17th Annual ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest Final Report; 1993 ACM Programming Contest World Finals

notes: The only source is the ICPC wiki history page for the 1993 World Finals (held 1993-02-17, Indianapolis); it does not mention the Rocky Mountain Regional or Metro State Denver. It links the 1993 World Finals problem set PDF and final standings, which belong to wf-1993, not this contest.
